data.name: Arfanaht
data.gender_notes: Arfanaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arfanaht means 'a fragrant garden' in Arabic and Urdu, conveying the beauty and grace of nature. This name is often given to baby girls to signify their freshness, purity, and charm. The name Arfanaht carries the meaning “Fragrant Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Arfanaht usually hope their child will grow to embody fragrant garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Arfanaht is a spiritual name that signifies the presence of fragrance and purity in one's heart and soul. It reminds us of the beauty and grace of nature and the importance of living a pure and virtuous life.
data.etymology: Arfanaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fragrant Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arfanaht total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
